title: Without a QuickBooks connection the QuickBooks column is not shown
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • {Location-A} is not connected to QuickBooks (for example a location that has never been connected).
  • Category {Category-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC34 alpha) exists.
  • Category {Category-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC34 Beta) exists.
  • You are on a page other than Categories.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Categories in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Look at the column headers of the list.
  3. Click the Name column header.
  4. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  5. Read the Name header arrow and the order of {Category-A} and {Category-B}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: there is no QuickBooks Products And Services column, so there is no QuickBooks sort to use. The Name column is shown.
  • Step 5: the Name header arrow points down and {Category-B} is above {Category-A}. The Name column still sorts.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10134 (Story 1, Categories, sort by name; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S1-N1, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.2 (Categories - after), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Price/Category QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N1: “If the shop is not connected to QuickBooks, the QuickBooks Products and Services column is not shown, and no sort is available for it.”
  • SV-10134 acceptance criteria: “Given the shop is not connected to QuickBooks, then that column and its sort are absent and the Name column still sorts.”
